summary: Acquittal on sanction grounds overturned; Sections 19(3)(a) and 465 Cr.P.C. applied; failure of justice test requires actual prejudice to investigation/trial; absence of sanction-approving official testimony not fatal; prior acquittal by High Court reversed under statutory presumption;
legal_provisions_cited: Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 s.7, s.13(1)(d) r/w 13(2)
State of Bihar v. Rajmangal Ram
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; conviction restored; High Court acquittal set aside.
